categories.title: Dungeon
categories.info: All Dungeons have timed entrance period and Dungeon Bosses are random. Acquire **Ancient Technology Points** and other rare loot by completing the dungeons.

categories.title: Fast Travel
categories.info: Unlocking Fast Travel locations grants **Technology Points**

categories.title: Egg
categories.info: Egg spawn points are fixed, but the type of egg that spawns is random. Pal Eggs respawn.

categories.title: Elemental Chest
categories.info: *Element is random; can be Fire, Water, or Electric.*

categories.title: Skill Fruit Tree
categories.info: Each Tree grows 3 random Skill Fruits. They regrow over time

categories.title: Treasure Chest
categories.info: Treasure Chests have fixed spawn locations, but the type of chest (Gold, Purple, Red, White, etc.) is random.

categories.title: Enemy Camp
categories.info: Enemies in the camps respawn over time, but the turrets in camps do not respawn

categories.title: Captured Pal
categories.info: Unlock the cell to capture the Pal
